definitions.explanation: The world in which people live; society and its customs, trends, and realities.

examples.english: There are all kinds of people in the world.

examples.japanese: {世|よ}の{中|なか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
{世|よ}の{中|なか}⟦{甘|あま}くない→甘い：00617_amai⟧。
examples.english: Life isn't easy. / The world is harsh.

notes:
USAGE: {世|よ}の{中|なか} refers to society and the realities of life. It's often used to make general statements about how the world works.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {世|よ}の{中|なか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜 (the world is ~)
- {世|よ}の{中|なか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to go out into the world)
- {世|よ}の{中|なか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ (to get along in the world)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ - world (physical/global)
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ - society (more formal)
- ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧ - the public, society
